possession or under the control of the organisation, and the organisation shall correct

Duty to notify. Where an organisation assesses that a data breach is a
notifiable data breach, the organisation must notify the Commission as soon as is
practicable, and in any case no later than 3 calendar days after making that
assessment, and must notify affected individuals where the breach is likely to result
in significant harm.

organisation has intentionally or negligently contravened a provision of this Act,
require the organisation to pay a financial penalty of an amount not exceeding 10% of
the organisation's annual turnover in Singapore or S$1 million, whichever is higher.
